purpose.text: Configures polled audio endpoint behavior at its owning API boundary. Sets the queue capacity frames available to `PolledAudioEndpointConfig`. Contains the max batch frames owned or reported by `PolledAudioEndpointConfig`.

responsibilities: pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioEndpointConfig: Configures polled audio endpoint behavior at its owning API boundary.
PolledAudioEndpointConfig::queue_capacity_frames: Sets the queue capacity frames available to `PolledAudioEndpointConfig`.
PolledAudioEndpointConfig::max_batch_frames: Contains the max batch frames owned or reported by `PolledAudioEndpointConfig`.
PolledAudioEndpointConfig::max_outstanding_leases: Contains the max outstanding leases owned or reported by `PolledAudioEndpointConfig`.
default: Returns the default `PolledAudioEndpointConfig` value.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioEndpointConfigError: Classifies failures surfaced by polled audio endpoint config operations.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioEndpointConfigError::ZeroQueueCapacity: Reports that queue capacity must be greater than zero.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioEndpointConfigError::ZeroBatchCapacity: Reports that batch capacity must be greater than zero.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioEndpointConfigError::ZeroLeaseCapacity: Reports that lease capacity must be greater than zero.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioEndpointConfigError::QueueCapacityTooLarge: Reports that queue capacity exceeds the supported size limit.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioEndpointConfigError::BatchCapacityTooLarge: Reports that batch capacity exceeds the supported size limit.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioEndpointConfigError::LeaseCapacityTooLarge: Reports that lease capacity exceeds the supported size limit.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioObservations: Reports the polled audio observations collected at an observation boundary.
PolledAudioObservations::registered_endpoints: References the registered endpoints participating in `PolledAudioObservations`.
PolledAudioObservations::queue_capacity_frames: Sets the queue capacity frames available to `PolledAudioObservations`.
PolledAudioObservations::queue_depth_frames: Reports the queue depth frames observed by `PolledAudioObservations`.
PolledAudioObservations::queue_peak_frames: Reports the queue peak frames observed by `PolledAudioObservations`.
PolledAudioObservations::queue_depth_invariant_failures_total: Counts the total number of queue depth invariant failures observed by `PolledAudioObservations`.
PolledAudioObservations::frames_received_total: Counts the total number of frames received observed by `PolledAudioObservations`.
PolledAudioObservations::frames_delivered_total: Counts the total number of frames delivered observed by `PolledAudioObservations`.
PolledAudioObservations::queue_full_drops_total: Counts the total number of queue full drops observed by `PolledAudioObservations`.
PolledAudioObservations::invalid_ownership_drops_total: Counts the total number of invalid ownership drops observed by `PolledAudioObservations`.
PolledAudioObservations::lease_capacity_count: Sets the lease capacity count available to `PolledAudioObservations`.
PolledAudioObservations::outstanding_leases: Contains the outstanding leases owned or reported by `PolledAudioObservations`.
PolledAudioObservations::lease_exhausted_total: Counts the total number of lease exhausted observed by `PolledAudioObservations`.
PolledAudioObservations::batches_polled_total: Counts the total number of batches polled observed by `PolledAudioObservations`.
PolledAudioObservations::frames_polled_total: Counts the total number of frames polled observed by `PolledAudioObservations`.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioPollError: Classifies failures surfaced by polled audio poll operations.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioPollError::Empty: Represents an empty value or collection.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioPollError::LeaseCapacityExhausted: Reports that the available lease capacity range or capacity is exhausted.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioPollError::StatePoisoned: Reports that shared state became unavailable after a panic while locked.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioReceipt: Retains the identity and observation access returned for polled audio.
try_poll: Attempts to poll through `PolledAudioReceipt`.
observations: Returns the observations exposed by `PolledAudioReceipt`.
wait_poll: Waits for a batch until the finite deadline expires.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioBatchLease: Holds the ownership or bounded access represented by polled audio batch lease.
len: Returns the number of values held by `PolledAudioBatchLease`.
is_empty: Returns whether `PolledAudioBatchLease` contains no values.
frame: Returns the frame held by `PolledAudioBatchLease`.
drop: Releases resources owned by `PolledAudioBatchLease`.
pocketstation::endpoint::polled_audio_driver::PolledAudioFrame: Carries one polled audio payload together with its declared metadata.
lineage: Returns the frame lineage carried by `PolledAudioFrame`.
endpoint_id: Returns the endpoint identifier held by `PolledAudioFrame`.
route_id: Returns the route identifier held by `PolledAudioFrame`.
route_enqueued_at_ns: Returns the route enqueued at nanoseconds held by `PolledAudioFrame`.
route_received_at_ns: Returns the route received at nanoseconds held by `PolledAudioFrame`.
endpoint_enqueued_at_ns: Returns the endpoint enqueued at nanoseconds held by `PolledAudioFrame`.
polled_at_ns: Returns the polled at nanoseconds held by `PolledAudioFrame`.
stream_id: Returns the stream identifier held by `PolledAudioFrame`.
connector_id: Returns the connector identifier held by `PolledAudioFrame`.
sample_rate_hz: Returns the sample rate hertz held by `PolledAudioFrame`.
channels: Returns the channel count represented by `PolledAudioFrame`.
samples: Returns the audio samples held by `PolledAudioFrame`.
